controls.name: stopwords-kept
controls.classification: decision: Tokenize keeps stopwords (the filter of InitStopwords' list removed)

controls.name: query-terms-deduplicated
controls.find: if ts.len() == 0 { qz() } else { qadd(score(st, idf, ts.drop_last(), d), occ(st, idf, ts.last(), d)) }
controls.replace: if ts.len() == 0 { qz() } else if ts.drop_last().contains(ts.last()) { score(st, idf, ts.drop_last(), d) } else { qadd(score(st, idf, ts.drop_last(), d), occ(st, idf, ts.last(), d)) }
controls.classification: decision: a repeated query term counted once (the owner says each time)

controls.name: unknown-terms-scored
controls.find: pub open spec fn known(st: Stats, t: Tok) -> bool { (st.df)(t) > 0 }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn known(st: Stats, t: Tok) -> bool { true }
controls.classification: guard: SearchCore's df = 0 tests removed (an unknown query term counts as known: it is scored, and it can be the cutoff's lowest-df term)

controls.name: no-fallback
controls.find: over(st, t, fnum, fden) && !(all_over(st, q, fnum, fden) && min_tok(st, q) == Some(t))
controls.classification: decision: the cutoff skips every common term, answering nothing (the fallback of 263-290 removed)

controls.name: left-to-right-denominator
controls.find: Q { num: 20 * tf * total, den: 8 * tf * total + 3 * total + 9 * len * n }
controls.replace: Q { num: 5 * tf * total, den: (2 * tf + 3) * len * n }
controls.classification: value: the pre-4.2.0 denominator (tf + k1) * (len / avgdl), evaluated left to right

controls.name: idf-without-plus-one
controls.replace: Q { num: 2 * n - 2 * df + 1, den: 2 * df + 1 }
controls.classification: value: classic Robertson IDF ln((N - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5)) without the + 1 (negative for common terms)

controls.name: ties-by-key-only
controls.find: pub open spec fn before(ka: int, a: int, kb: int, b: int) -> bool { ka > kb || (ka == kb && a < b) }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn before(ka: int, a: int, kb: int, b: int) -> bool { ka > kb }
controls.classification: decision: the sort subscript keyed by score alone (tied documents collide)

controls.name: schema2-reads-stored
controls.classification: read: schema 2 using the IDF stored at build (no query-time IDF)

controls.name: parse-keeps-ids
controls.find: let ins = c == '.' && lead(prev) && s.len() > 1 && is_digit(s[1]);
controls.classification: reader (repair direction of F-C0715): bm25_search's `_parse` leaves the ids alone

controls.name: numeric-ids-as-text
controls.classification: provider premise flipped for this case: numeric ids no longer compare by value (9 and 10 in text order put 10 first)

controls.name: text-case-folded
controls.classification: collation altered: character codes compared in reverse (dB/da and d10/d9 swap)

controls.name: sql-entry-validates-k
controls.replace: Entry::Sql => if k < 1 { KAns::Refused } else { KAns::Answer(taken(k, ranked)) },
controls.classification: repair of bug-srch-113: kg_BM25 refuses k < 1 like the other two readers

controls.name: nonpositive-k-takes-all
controls.find: pub open spec fn taken(k: int, ranked: nat) -> nat { if k <= 0 { 0 }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn taken(k: int, ranked: nat) -> nat { if k <= 0 { ranked }
controls.classification: decision: SearchCore's `count >= k` guard before the first document removed (k <= 0 answers everything)
